t: 按照"荷兰威斯敏斯特条约"的规定,将新尼德兰割让给英国.
te: As provided in the Treaty of Westminster, Netherlands cedes New Netherland to England.
dz: 第三次盎格鲁-荷兰战争:按照"荷兰威斯敏斯特条约"的规定,将新尼德兰割让给英国.
de: Third Anglo-Dutch War: As provided in the Treaty of Westminster, Netherlands cedes New Netherland to England.

dz: 查特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉·马哈拉伊(Chattrapati Shivaji Maharaj),马拉塔国王在被通称为"普拉塔普加尔之战"(Battle of Pratapgarh)中杀死了阿夫扎尔·可汗,阿迪尔沙希.
de: Chattrapati Shivaji Maharaj, Maratha King kills Afzal Khan, Adilshahi in the battle popularly known as Battle of Pratapgarh.

dz: 阿波·布拉德巴斯:十四名反对查尔斯公爵的贵族被斩首于图尔库老大广场(瑞典语:Abo),因为他们参与了对西吉斯蒙德的战争.
de: Åbo Bloodbath: Fourteen noblemen who opposed Duke Charles are decapitated in the Old Great Square of Turku (Swedish: Åbo) for their involvement in the War against Sigismund.

dz: 瓦尔纳之战：波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫三世（又名匈牙利乌拉斯洛一世和瓦尔纳瓦迪斯瓦夫三世）的十字军被苏丹穆拉德二世领导的土耳其人击败，瓦迪斯瓦夫被杀。
de: Battle of Varna: The crusading forces of King Władysław III of Poland (aka Ulaszlo I of Hungary and Władysław III of Varna) are defeated by the Turks under Sultan Murad II and Władysław is killed.

dz: Raden Wijaya 加冕为爪哇满者伯夷王国的第一位君主，王位名为 Kertarajasa Jayawardhana。
de: Raden Wijaya is crowned as the first monarch of Majapahit kingdom of Java, taking the throne name Kertarajasa Jayawardhana.

te: Despite letters from Pope Innocent III forbidding it and threatening excommunication, Catholic crusaders begin a siege …
dz: 第四次十字军东征：尽管教皇英诺森三世写信禁止十字军东征并威胁逐出教会，天主教十字军仍开始围攻扎拉（现克罗地亚扎达尔）。
de: Fourth Crusade: Despite letters from Pope Innocent III forbidding it and threatening excommunication, Catholic crusaders begin a siege of Zara (now Zadar, Croatia).

dz: 十国：李昙篡位，废帝杨溥。李（现称“徐知高”）取代了吴国，成为南唐的第一位统治者。
de: Ten Kingdoms: Li Bian usurps the throne and deposes Emperor Yang Pu. The Wu State is replaced by Li (now called "Xu Zhigao"), who becomes the first ruler of Southern Tang.

de: Emperor Leo II dies after a reign of ten months. He is succeeded by his father Zeno, who becomes sole ruler of the Byzantine Empire.
